notes.title: We are crowd funding Ye Fenny 2!
notes.notes:
Hello fans of Ye Fenny,

We're happy to announce, we are [b]Crowd Funding[/b] our second game, Ye Fenny 2 - Whiplin's Retribution.

IndieGoGo page link: https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/ye-fenny-2-whiplin-s-retribution/x/19285851

If you enjoy games with action packed shooting, gore, live action graphics, FMV cutscenes, heavy metal fight music, awesome atmospheric music, and crazy funny story lines. I'm sure you will love our new project, Ye Fenny 2 - Whiplin's Retribution.

Why no head on over to our IndieGoGo page for great perks!

Many thanks,
Team DPAD-FTW.

notes.title: Ye Fenny has a demo coming soon!
notes.notes:
Yes, that's right, a demo! You don't really see these about the gaming scene these days. But we want to give you all a good look at what you are all missing out on.

The demo provides you with 3 levels along with a bonus stage level, and 2 bosses to fight it out with! We also included some of the cutscenes for you to watch between levels.

We hope you all will enjoy this, happy gaming everyone!

Dave Jones,
DPAD-FTW.

notes.title: Updated to Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and thank you for the support we have got for our game.

Just a quick update:
- Fixed various little bugs with some A.I.
- Fixed the load game bug. When no save data was present and load game was selected, a new game would start, but once the player was in the game, all lives would be lost and would cause a loop which would constantly reset the game.

notes.title: Ye Fenny!
notes.notes:
A Fenny Welcome to all Steam users.

My name is Dave, programmer and project lead of Ye Fenny from DPAD-FTW. 
We are very excite to bring you all our very first action adventure game, Ye Fenny. This project has been a labour of love, care and craft. Throughout Ye Fenny’s development (2.5 Years) we have had some ups and downs and plenty of laughs.

It’s a video game which doesn’t take itself too seriously, as you will be able to tell by the cinematic movies in the game. The gameplay is simple yet effective in order to progress, you will find your way in sticky situations with hard hitting bosses, but there is always a way to prevail! 

The music and sound effects will bring you right back to the 80s / 90’s, when you used to sit in front of your CRT TV playing your favourite console or computer of the time. The story while cheesy and campy will keep you wanting to progress through the game to find out more!

Thank you for checking out our game, Ye Fenny. We hope you all enjoy it. :D
